input.quote: 14.9 Bankruptcy. The parties hereto agree that Corio, as a licensee of Commerce One's intellectual property, shall be afforded all of the protections afforded to a licensee under Section 365(n) of the United States Bankruptcy Code
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance provision anywhere; the only occurrence of "insurance" is in the definition of net revenue (p0012). Commerce One is the vendor here: it supplies an on-site operations consultant and professional services (Sections 5.1, 5.2, 5.6) and operates the MarketSite.net Service, so it touches our personnel, premises and data. Absent coverage for a services/hosting vendor is walk-away territory under the rule, so we insert the preferred package (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, statutory workers' compensation, cyber USD 5M where our data is processed, certificates on request) as new Section 14.10, renumbering the existing entire-agreement clause. The fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) is offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert a vendor insurance provision (CGL, E&O, workers' comp, cyber) in Section 14
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance provision even though Commerce One places consultants on site, performs professional services and operates the MarketSite.net Service. We have added our standard coverage requirements (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M where our data is processed, statutory workers' compensation) with certificates on request; if helpful, we can accept E&O of USD 1M and cyber of USD 2M.

ops.text: Insurance. Commerce One shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: (a) commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; (b) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; (c) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law; and (d) where Commerce One processes Corio or Customer data, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000. Commerce One shall provide Corio with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon request.
